svg.title: AtomSense data engineering architecture
svg.desc: Five-layer pipeline: IoT devices → Kafka → DuckDB/Spark → Delta Lake → FastAPI + Streamlit dashboard

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I simulate IoT device telemetry with Python for AtomSense?')

svg.text: Cost optimization rationale (mention this to judges)
DuckDB replaces BigQuery/Redshift — zero cloud cost, OLAP-speed queries in-process
Delta Lake on local fs replaces S3 — same API, no egress fees, portable
